headline: Chicago O'Hare is running behind the other United hubs today.

items.text: Chicago O'Hare is the lowest of the seven United hubs reporting: 79% of departures so far today left within 30 minutes of schedule (460 departed).
The other hubs are running normally, and no FAA ground stop or ground delay program is in effect at any United hub.
The FAA has a ground delay program in effect for flights into Seattle until 9:59 PM PT; delays average 32 minutes, up to 82 minutes.

The FAA's operations plan says a ground stop or ground delay program is possible for flights into Newark tomorrow after 10:00 AM ET and into San Francisco tomorrow after 7:00 AM PT. Neither is in effect.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying into Seattle, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
